meta.title: Zicode tools
meta.description: Developer utilities at the sidebar foot, just above Settings, or press Alt+Shift+Z (Ctrl+Alt+Z on web): ASCII table and code lookup, Base64/URL/HTML/Unicode/hex conversion, password generator, JSON formatting and validation, color conversion, timestamps, UUID batches and SHA hashes. Everything is computed locally in the browser; nothing is sent over the network or read from the session.
